parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application. The wildcard character (\*) is supported. An asterisk (\*) represents all applications under the specified domain name. For more information, see [Stream management](~~197397~~).

parameters.name: Duration
parameters.description: The duration of an HTTP Live Streaming (HLS) transport stream (TS) segment. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: IgnoreTranscode
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable time shifting for transcoded streams. Valid values:

- **true**: Time shifting is disabled for transcoded streams.

- **false**: Time shifting is enabled for transcoded streams.

Default value: true.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the stream. The wildcard character (\*) is supported. An asterisk (\*) represents all streams under the specified application. For more information, see [Stream management](~~197397~~).

parameters.name: Vision
parameters.description: The data retention period. The default value is 7. Unit: days.
